weeks.title: Week 1: Core Concepts
weeks.html:
Executive Summary

Silverado Construction, a $40M revenue residential/commercial builder, faces competitive pressure requiring digital transformation to achieve industry-leading financial close capabilities while improving operational efficiency.

Company Profile

Revenue: $40M annually (65% residential, 35% commercial)

Projects: 25-30 active across 4 states

Employees: 125 total (25 office, 100 field)

Current Systems: Ledgerline 300 Construction (legacy), manual processes

Challenges: 22-day close, limited visibility, manual WIP

Current State Analysis

Financial Close Timeline:

Cost of Current Process:

Personnel Investment:

Controller: 22 × 8 hours = 176 hours

Senior Accountant: 22 × 6 hours = 132 hours

Staff Accountant: 22 × 4 hours = 88 hours

Project Managers: 5 × 20 hours = 100 hours

Total: 496 hours × $65 average = $32,240 monthly

Annual Cost: $386,880

Opportunity Cost: $500,000 (delayed decisions, late reporting)

Digital Transformation Strategy

Phase 1: Foundation Technology (Months 1-3)

Ledgerline Intacct Implementation:

Multi-dimensional accounting structure

Real-time integration with job costing

Automated workflow processes

Advanced reporting capabilities

Investment:

Software: $65,000 annually

Implementation: $125,000 one-time

Training: $35,000

Total: $225,000

Phase 2: Process Automation (Months 4-6)

RPA for High-Volume Activities:

Bank Reconciliation:

Current: 32 hours monthly

Automated: 3 hours monthly

Savings: 29 hours = $15,660 annually

Invoice Processing:

Current: 1,200 invoices × $8.50 = $10,200 monthly

Automated: 1,200 × $3.25 = $3,900 monthly

Savings: $75,600 annually

Phase 3: Advanced Analytics (Months 7-9)

Real-Time Dashboard Components:

Financial Performance (Revenue, Margin, EBITDA)

Cash Position (13-week forecast, covenants)

Project Portfolio (status, margins, schedules)

Operational Metrics (productivity, safety, quality)

Market Intelligence (backlog, pipeline, competition)

Implementation Results

12-Month Performance Metrics:

ROI Analysis:

Three-Year Investment:

Year 1: $465,000 (software + implementation + training)

Year 2: $90,000 (software + support)

Year 3: $90,000 (software + support)

Total: $645,000

Three-Year Benefits:

Personnel Savings: $180,000 × 3 = $540,000

Opportunity Recovery: $250,000 × 3 = $750,000

Decision Improvement: $150,000 × 3 = $450,000

Total: $1,740,000

Net ROI: ($1,740,000 - $645,000) ÷ $645,000 = 170%

Payback: 18 months
